patch_description: Add a short confirmation hysteresis for slope sign changes. The current alpha-beta tracker can reverse its slope estimate from a single noisy innovation, which explains the elevated slope-change and false-reversal counts despite good tracking accuracy. The replacement requires two consecutive, noise-significant slope proposals in the new direction before accepting a reversal. While confirmation is pending, the existing slope is only gently decayed, preventing noise-driven direction flips while retaining rapid acceptance of sustained genuine turns. The normal same-direction update is unchanged in character, preserving responsiveness and low latency.
